title: bug: the moe-daemon Docker image binds 127.0.0.1 inside the container and serves the project as /project, so the documented docker run -p 9876:9876 -v PROJECT:/project (and docker-compose up) yields a daemon no host client can use: the published port refuses connections and a host moe-proxy rejects its daemon.json as another project's
description:
Defect hunt #8 (task-21d671c1), lane 2: Docker and packaging drift. This row confirms hunt #7's unverified lead (c). HEAD b5f40fee.

PROBLEM
1. Loopback bind.
   - packages/moe-daemon/Dockerfile:54-55 runs `node dist/index.js start --project /project`. Its only ENV is MOE_PROJECT_PATH (:47): no --host and no MOE_BIND_HOST.
   - docker-compose.yml (repo root) publishes "9876:9876" at :10 and sets neither, at :14-17.
   - The daemon takes --host, else MOE_BIND_HOST, else nothing (packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts:65-70). startDaemon then binds DEFAULT_BIND_HOST (index.ts:646), which is '127.0.0.1' (src/server/probeHost.ts:11).
   - In a container that is the container's own loopback. Docker's -p forwards to the container's network interface, where nothing listens.
   - The HEALTHCHECK (Dockerfile:50-51, compose :19) probes localhost from inside the container, so it cannot see this.
2. Project identity.
   - The recipe mounts the project at /project: Dockerfile:47 and :55, compose :13 and :15, docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:451 and docs/CONFIGURATION.md:133-135.
   - So the container daemon writes daemon.json with projectPath "/project" into the mounted .moe/, and answers /health with projectPath "/project".
   - A host moe-proxy for that same project refuses both. readDaemonInfoResult returns the non-retryable "daemon.json belongs to a different project" (packages/moe-proxy/src/utils.ts:138-143), and connect() exits 1 on it (packages/moe-proxy/src/index.ts:504-508).
   - The proxy's /health probe (index.ts:529-539) and the JetBrains plugin's DaemonIdentity.classify (moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/DaemonIdentity.kt:78) compare the same two paths.
3. Coverage and docs.
   - docs/CONFIGURATION.md:133-136's docker run publishes no port at all.
   - The PR job's only image test is `docker run --rm moe-daemon-test --version` (.github/workflows/docker.yml:71-79). Nothing starts the server.

EVIDENCE
Run on HEAD b5f40fee, outside the shared checkout. This host has no Docker, so I ran the image's ENTRYPOINT, CMD and ENV from a git-archive snapshot whose dist I built with tsc, moving only the port off 9876. Docker's -p forwards to the container's eth0; the WSL eth0 address stands in for it.
- `/mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-21d671c1/docker-cmd-repro.sh /tmp/hunt-21d6-snap/packages/moe-daemon /tmp/hunt-21d6-proj 19876`. Full output: docker-cmd-repro.default.out, next to the script.
    LISTEN 0 511 127.0.0.1:19876 0.0.0.0:* users:(("MainThread",pid=534736,fd=26))
    curl http://127.0.0.1:19876/health -> exit=0 { "status": "healthy", "version": "0.8.0", … "projectPath": "/tmp/hunt-21d6-proj" …
    curl http://172.26.208.246:19876/health -> exit=7 curl: (7) Failed to connect to 172.26.208.246 port 19876 after 0 ms: Couldn't connect to server
- The same command with `MOE_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0` appended (docker-cmd-repro.bind0.out):
    LISTEN 0 511 0.0.0.0:19876
    the eth0 curl answers "status": "healthy"
    daemon.json gains "bindHost": "0.0.0.0"
- `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-21d671c1/docker-mount-identity-repro.mjs /tmp/hunt-21d6-snap/packages/moe-proxy/dist /tmp/hunt-21d6-hostproj` writes the daemon.json the container writes (projectPath "/project") into a host project, then prints:
    readDaemonInfoResult(host project) -> {"info":null,"retryable":false,"error":"daemon.json belongs to a different project"}

FIX DIRECTION
- Dockerfile:
  - Add ENV MOE_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0. That binds the container's own interfaces; the host decides exposure through -p.
  - Change CMD to ["start"], so MOE_PROJECT_PATH names the project (index.ts:67) instead of a hard-coded `--project /project`.
- docker-compose.yml, and every docker run in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md's Docker section (:439-465) and docs/CONFIGURATION.md (:128-138):
  - Publish on host loopback only: 127.0.0.1:9876:9876. /mcp has no authentication, and a bare -p publishes on every host interface.
  - Mount the project at the same absolute path that MOE_PROJECT_PATH names, e.g. `-v "$PWD":"$PWD" -e MOE_PROJECT_PATH="$PWD"` (compose: `${PWD}:${PWD}` with MOE_PROJECT_PATH=${PWD}).
  - On a Windows host, mount D:\x at /mnt/d/x. The proxy's comparableProjectPath already treats those as one project (packages/moe-proxy/src/utils.ts:37-46).
  - Add one sentence on why each change is needed.
- .github/workflows/docker.yml, PR "Test Docker image" step: after the --version check, start the image detached with the checkout mounted at its own runner path (its .moe/project.json is tracked) and published on 127.0.0.1. The step must fail unless `curl http://127.0.0.1:<port>/health` from the runner reports "status": "healthy" with that projectPath. Stop the container by name on every exit path.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, .github/workflows/docker.yml.
None is held by an open row: per lanes.js at 19:09Z, task-b22f82b2 (docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) is DONE. Do not touch docs/MCP_SERVER.md (held).

Running /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-21d671c1/docker-cmd-repro.sh on a git-archive snapshot of the fix with that ENV value appended (MOE_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0) prints a `0.0.0.0:19876` LISTEN line, and /health answers healthy on the eth0 address.

implementationPlan.description:
Edit .github/workflows/docker.yml, in the PR-only step 'Test Docker image'. Keep its name, its `if`, and the existing build and --version check. Then append the block from /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-90ed6cb5/ref/.github/workflows/docker.yml. It is the regression test for this row:
- Cleanup, set up first: `name="moe-daemon-health-${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-$$"` (keep both dollar signs), then a `cleanup` function trapped on EXIT. The function:
  - saves `rc=$?`;
  - prints `docker logs "$name" 2>&1 | tail -n 40` only when rc is not 0;
  - runs `docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true`;
  - ends with `exit "$rc"`.
  So the container is removed on every exit path, and the step's status is kept.
- Start: `docker run -d --name "$name" --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -p 127.0.0.1::9876 -v "$PWD":"$PWD" -e MOE_PROJECT_PATH="$PWD" moe-daemon-test`.
  - $PWD is the checkout, and its .moe/project.json is tracked.
  - Docker picks a free host port on 127.0.0.1. Read it with `docker port "$name" 9876/tcp | head -n 1`, then `${port##*:}`.
  - Without --user, a checkout owned by a uid other than the image's 1001 crash-loops on EACCES at .moe/daemon.lock (observed on this host).
- Poll `curl -fsS -m 2 "http://127.0.0.1:$port/health"` up to 30 times, 1 s apart. Put the curl inside an `if`, so `bash -e` does not abort the loop.
- Check the answer with `node -e`, passing HEALTH and EXPECTED in env.
  - JSON.parse runs inside try/catch.
  - It fails unless status is "healthy" and projectPath === $PWD. The failure prints `Expected a healthy daemon serving <path> on 127.0.0.1, got: <body or no answer>`.
  - Success prints `healthy: <projectPath>`.
  - checkRef red greps the failure line, and green greps both.
- Run the image's own HEALTHCHECK inside the container: `docker exec "$name" sh -c "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Healthcheck.Test 1}}' moe-daemon-test)"`, then `echo "image HEALTHCHECK passed"`. This is the regression test for step 1's 127.0.0.1 probe.

Error handling: every failure path exits non-zero through the trap, which shows the logs and removes the container. A crashed container leaves `docker port` empty, so curl fails and the logs say why.

The PR step 'Test Docker image' starts the built image that way. planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected alternatives:
(1) A Docker-free emulation (a fake docker shim). Docker Engine 29.8.1 runs on this WSL host; the hunt's 'no Docker' note was wrong. So the gate builds the real image and runs the real step script, extracted from the YAML.
(2) A fixed `-p 127.0.0.1:9876:9876` in the CI step. A Docker-assigned host port cannot collide on a shared host. The docs keep 9876 on both sides, because clients read the container's daemon.json port.
(3) MOE_BIND_HOST '::'. The DoD fixes 0.0.0.0, so the probes target 127.0.0.1 instead.
(4) Keeping the HEALTHCHECK on localhost. Observed: 'Connecting to localhost:9876 ([::1]:9876) … Connection refused' against a 0.0.0.0 bind.
(5) Omitting --user. Observed: uid 1001 on a uid-1000 mount gives EACCES at .moe/daemon.lock and a supervisor crash loop. The GitHub runner happens to be uid 1001, so CI alone would never show it.
(6) Dropping the /project default. It is kept for backward compatibility.
(7) A YAML-only static check of the workflow. The extracted script is executed instead.
